verdict.rationale: Radar lets users write custom rules on supported attributes, defined in the Dashboard. These rules automatically act on payment events: request 3DS, block by location or card origin, send to review, or allow listed customers. Rules can also auto-pause payouts on high-dispute accounts, and value lists can be referenced inside rules. Missing for 10: actions limited to a fixed set of payment/fraud responses rather than arbitrary triggers, no evidence rules can be authored programmatically (community notes 'lack of easy programmatic control'), allow rules gated behind support enablement for newer businesses, and little independent hands-on corroboration of rule authoring.
